save_run.description: Stores validation results - may contain code snippets in markdown

validate_run.description: Previews validation results - may contain code snippets in markdown

create_issue.description: Creates issues - file paths may reference sensitive files being reported on

add_issue_note.description: Issue notes may contain code snippets. issue_id is UUID (can trigger CC false positive)

update_status.description: Status updates contain UUIDs that can trigger credit card pattern false positives

bulk_update_status.description: Bulk status updates contain UUIDs that can trigger credit card pattern false positives

get_issue_details.description: Issue ID is UUID that can trigger credit card pattern false positives

get_issue_history.description: Issue ID is UUID that can trigger credit card pattern false positives

edit_issue.description: Edit issue metadata - issue_id is UUID

merge_issues.description: Merge issues - IDs are UUIDs that can trigger credit card pattern false positives

update_run.description: Update run metadata - raw_markdown may contain code snippets

soft_delete_project.description: Soft delete project - confirmation_phrase is user-provided text

delete_run.description: Delete run - run_id is UUID that can trigger false positives

get_run.description: Get run by UUID - run_id can trigger credit card pattern false positives

update_issue_by_fingerprint.description: Update issue by fingerprint - fingerprint is SHA-256 hash

get_issue_by_fingerprint.description: Get issue by fingerprint - fingerprint is SHA-256 hash

undo_issue_status.description: Undo issue status - issue_id is UUID
